About TasteEast

TasteEast prepares Japanese, Korean, and Thai-inspired meals, desserts, and drinks made fresh to order. We focus on balanced flavors, quality ingredients, and reliable service for delivery and pick-up in Sagay City and nearby areas.

Open daily from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Free delivery on orders of ₱200 and above. Most orders are ready within 20–40 minutes. Pay conveniently via GCash or Cash on Delivery.

FAQ

How long does delivery take?

Most orders are ready and delivered within 20–40 minutes, depending on your location and order size.

What is the minimum order for free delivery?

Free delivery is available on orders of ₱200 and above within Sagay City and nearby areas.

How do I pay?

You can pay via GCash or Cash on Delivery. For GCash, send payment after placing your order and we will confirm once received.

Do you deliver outside Sagay City?

We deliver in Sagay City and nearby areas. Message us to confirm if your location is covered.

Can I request changes for allergies?

Yes. Please mention any allergies or dietary requests in the order note and we will do our best to accommodate.

What is the last order time?

Last orders are accepted until 8:30 PM. We close at 9:00 PM.
